title: Annealing temperature and CO oxidation activity of a Co/Al2O3 catalyst

paragraphs.text: This study examines how annealing temperature affects the CO oxidation activity of a Co/Al2O3 catalyst.
After annealing at 350 °C the Co/Al2O3 catalyst reached a CO conversion of 78% (p = 0.02).
The 450 °C sample reached a CO conversion of 62%, whereas the 350 °C sample reached 78%.
Only the 350 °C and 450 °C annealing conditions were tested; higher annealing temperatures were not evaluated.
